Local Structural Centrality

Source: R/centrality-batch65.R
centrality_lsc.Rd

Local structural centrality (LSC; Gao et al. 2014) sums, over the neighbors of a node, the size of each neighbor's two-step neighborhood and the clustering inside it: $$LSC(v) = \sum_{u \in N(v)} \Bigl(\alpha\,|N_2(u)| + (1 - \alpha) \sum_{w \in N_2(u)} c_w\Bigr),$$ where \(N_2(u)\) holds the nodes one or two steps from \(u\) and \(c_w\) is the local clustering coefficient of \(w\).

Usage

centrality_lsc(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Network input accepted by centrality.

...

Further arguments to centrality. The measure uses lsc_alpha (the weight of the neighborhood size against the clustering sum, default 0.2).

Value

A named numeric vector with one score per node, in input node order.

Details

The measure is computed on the simple undirected skeleton of the network, so direction, weights, loops and parallel edges are ignored. lsc_alpha is 0.2 by default, the value the source fixes for all its experiments on real networks; its worked example uses 0.7. With lsc_alpha = 1 the clustering term drops out. The two-step neighborhood does not contain its center, and a node with fewer than two neighbors has clustering 0; both are what the values of the source require. Isolated nodes score 0. The implementation reproduces the ten values the source prints for its 28-node example at lsc_alpha = 0.7, on an edge list recovered from the other columns of the same table. A lsc_alpha outside \([0, 1]\) raises a cograph_bad_parameter error. normalized = TRUE divides the scores by their maximum.

References

Gao, S., Ma, J., Chen, Z., Wang, G. and Xing, C. (2014). Ranking the spreading ability of nodes in complex networks based on local structure. Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications, 403, 130-147. doi:10.1016/j.physa.2014.02.032 .

See also

centrality_semilocal, centrality_transitivity, centrality.

Examples

centrality_lsc(regulation_net)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>   25.89524   30.70857   36.09333   30.73524   25.68952   25.92190   20.80381 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>   25.90286   30.76190   25.74286 
centrality_lsc(regulation_net, lsc_alpha = 0.7)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>   37.83571   45.26571   52.91000   45.27571   37.75857   37.84571   30.30143 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>   37.83857   45.28571   37.77857
